scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const p of ['dist','release']) fs.rmSync(p,{ recursive:true, force:true });"
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.ci:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@8 sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted --no-input
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@8 lint --source-dir dist/firefox
